name: Yasaka (Shimane, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yasaka village emblem in white: a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke, enclosing a green stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Yasaka in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Yasaka village emblem — a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke, enclosing a green stylised character
